subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable runtime and wake-to-session delivery contract as a core architecture on the 2026.7.1 line?
rationale: The branch creates new core persistence, protocol, environment, and delivery semantics; repository evidence cannot determine whether maintainers want that permanent product boundary or release timing.

options.title: Pause for sponsorship
options.body: Require a maintainer-sponsored architecture issue and agreed stack order before continuing merge review.

options.title: Sponsor and restack
options.body: Approve the direction, land the predecessor contracts first, and require this final slice to be rebased narrowly with current-head proof.

options.title: Decline the core direction
options.body: Close the durable-core stack and preserve only independently useful fixes through separate focused PRs.

recommendation.title: Pause for sponsorship
recommendation.body: Require a maintainer-sponsored architecture issue and agreed stack order before continuing merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans core Gateway architecture, shared persistence, release sequencing, and CI policy rather than one isolated implementation file.
